title: IN WHICH FIX COMES FACE TO FACE WITH PHILEAS FOGG
summary_hover: Fogg discovers the Carnatic sailed early without them. Unfazed, he charters the Tankadere to take his party and a secretly thwarted Fix to Shanghai.
summary_detail: Unaware of Passepartout's drug-induced stupor, Fogg and Aouda arrive at the quay only to discover the Carnatic has sailed early. Undeterred by the setback, Fogg searches the docks and charters a small pilot-boat, the Tankadere, captained by John Bunsby, to reach Shanghai in time to catch the Pacific steamer. After leaving funds with the police to search for his missing servant, Fogg, Aouda, and a secretly disappointed Fix set sail.
